context_for_next_testing_agent: Collapsible tax forms and splash screen features verified. W-9 and W-8BEN sections in Employee Dashboard now use Radix Collapsible component with data-testid='w9-collapse-trigger' and data-testid='w8ben-collapse-trigger'. Sections start collapsed (false). Chevron icon rotates 180 degrees when expanded. Splash screen uses Framer Motion for animated colorful blob backgrounds (cyan, pink, purple) with GPU optimization hints.

collapsible_w9_section.details: W-9 Tax Form section expands/collapses on click. data-testid='w9-collapse-trigger' works correctly. Content (Submit W-9 button, Get W-9 Form button) shows/hides as expected.

collapsible_w8ben_section.details: W-8BEN (Foreign Employees) section expands/collapses on click. data-testid='w8ben-collapse-trigger' works correctly. Content (Submit W-8BEN button, Get W-8BEN Form button) shows/hides as expected.

chevron_rotation.details: ChevronDown icon rotates 180 degrees when sections expand (has rotate-180 class) and returns to normal when collapsed.

splash_screen_animated_blobs.details: Splash screen displays with gradient background (from-[#1A1A2E] via-[#16213E] to-[#0F3460]), animated colorful blobs (cyan, pink, purple using radial gradients), Thrifty Curator logo and branding text, and loading dots animation.

splash_screen_session_persistence.details: Splash screen sets sessionStorage 'hasSeenSplash' flag and does not show again on subsequent page loads within the same session.
